plugins.name: music-video
plugins.description: Make a beat-synced kinetic-typography music video about any company: researched topics, lyrics and a Suno prompt, then a 4K video with its own look, drawn as an HTML page and rendered with Playwright and ffmpeg. Optional extras: a full-length vertical 9:16 version for Reels and TikTok, shorts cut from it, cover posters, and stand-alone Shorts, new 15 to 35 s mini-songs in the voice of a finished video.
